description.value:
Requirements You are overflowing.

You can open your internal nexus, unleashing a destructive beam of magical energy that emanates from your hand, eyes, or chest. You fire a beam that deals @Damage[((floor(@actor.level/2)*2)-2)d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:line|distance:60] and pushes back anyone who stands within. Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your nexus DC. A creature that fails is also pushed back 10 feet (20 feet on a critical failure). The damage increases by 2d6 at 10th level and every 2 levels thereafter. You are no longer overflowing.
